shortBio.zh: 致力于揭露虚假测速与劣质代理陷阱的独立技术专家组，常驻上海、广州、成都三地物理机房，定期发布晚高峰天梯。
shortBio.en: Independent performance testing lab exposing speed fraud and evaluating 42 proxy providers across China.

biography.zh:
FreeVPN 实测实验室是由一群资深网络工程师、外贸运维专家与前沿 AI 开发者组成的独立技术研究组织。我们的唯一使命是：破除网络出海领域的虚假宣传与信息茧房。

实验室在上海电信千兆光纤、广州联通千兆骨干以及成都移动宽带部署了 7×24 小时自动化测试物理集群，每日对全网收录的 42 家主流机场品牌进行晚高峰（20:30–22:30 CST）极限压力测试。

我们坚持采集单线程吞吐量、TLS 握手延迟与 ICMP 探针丢包率三维核心数据，定期公开晚高峰测速天梯榜与 AI 原生住宅 IP 解锁矩阵白皮书，为全球出海中文用户提供最权威、最客观的网络基础设施选型指南。
biography.en:
FreeVPN Performance Testing Lab is an independent technical evaluation group composed of network engineers, DevOps specialists, and AI researchers. Our mission: eradicate deceptive marketing and speed fraud in the proxy ecosystem.

Operating automated testing clusters across China Telecom (Shanghai), China Unicom (Guangzhou), and China Mobile (Chengdu), the lab conducts rigorous peak-hour benchmarks (20:30–22:30 CST) against 42 active proxy providers.

By tracking single-thread throughput, TLS handshake RTT, and packet loss telemetry, our reports deliver unbiased, reproducible benchmarks for researchers, developers, and international professionals worldwide.

quote.zh: 拒绝公关费，坚持晚高峰单线程实机测速。
quote.en: Independent telemetry, zero marketing bias, peak-hour raw performance.
